notes.title: January 2016 Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fix Update! We've pushed the first patch of 2016 live. 

Fixed the issue where a lower frame-rate would disable input control
Default controller issue, now any connected controller is able to start a new game, not just Gamepad One.

If you have had a bad experience in the past give it another go. 

Thanks for your patience and thanks for playing ;) 

Stef @ SMG Studio

notes.title: Watch Out Guys...another patch incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey Guys

We've been squirreling away with a few fixes in One More Line this week. Good news for you 100%'ers, we fixed the 'Watch Out Guys...' achievement. It is now achievable!
Unless you already unlocked in which it truly was an achievement. How'd you do that?

We also fixed a few issues with resolution settings which included some of the options not working, and others turned of the sound as you selected them.


tl;dr 
       Watch out guys Achievement fixed
       More resolution options available
       Sound on resolution change fixed.

Thanks everyone for playing! Keep up the great work <3


SMG STUDIO

notes.title: One More Line: Patch Adams
notes.notes:
Hey Guys
New Patch out right now.

We were getting feedback regarding Chaos and survival modes where the winning player could just keep on playing for as long as they like.
Given the spirit of fast paced survival fun, we've modified it to end the moment the surviving player reaches the furthest.

The menu is a more controller and keyboard friendly beast now so for those who haven't the luxury of a mouse, REJOICE!

We'd love your feedback on these changes and as always keep in the Bug Thread and posting up screenshots. Everyone's doing a phenomenal job helping us make One More Line the best it can be.

Thanks for playing ;)

SMG Studio

notes.title: UPDATE: Single Player Controls + Adjusted Tutorial
notes.notes:
Firstly, shouting out our thanks to everyone who came and saw us at PAX Prime. We had a great time and we know you did to.

Anyways, Update news.
You spoke and we listened.

Space bar now lets you play Single Player sessions and the tutorial graphic has been adjusted to reflect this.

A lot of people were having trouble with the controls and upon reflection, the 'Q' key may have not been the most obvious of choices.

tl;dr = The game should be much easier to get a hold of for new players now.

Keep an ear to the ground and an eye on the forums. We'll be announcing new stuff soon.

Peace Out from Down Under

SMG STUDIO.
